detection.scope: frozen synthetic copy-paste benchmark from ONE field photo (130 positive scenes from 9 held-out crops + 40 procedural distractor-only negatives); field validation pending

verifier_gate.tau_selection: min(0.5, 1st percentile of VAL true-positive p_onion scores); keeps 1.0 of 373 val TPs

demo_photo.note: real 52-onion tray photo (source of all crops)

verifier_gate.scope: frozen test set (130 positive scenes from 9 held-out crops + 40 procedural distractor negatives); gate = TF verifier at tau

data.negative_source: procedural look-alike blobs + plain backgrounds + bright washes (fresh seeds, serving-matched crops)

verifier.scope: held-out 10 real test crops x8 augs vs fresh-seed procedural distractors; negatives are SYNTHETIC look-alikes, not photographs of real produce

condition.model: condition-ensemble-v2.0 (PyTorch MobileNetV2 CNN + calibrated RF + HSV heuristic -> logistic meta-fusion)

fusion_selection.policy: configuration chosen by VAL macro-F1; TEST scored once
fusion_selection.honest_note: on the frozen TEST split the CNN alone may score higher than the fusion; the fusion was selected on VAL and is served because it uses three independent signals, but both numbers are reported rather than hiding the comparison

condition.data_scope: frozen 12 test crops x 6 variants/class = 216 images, programmatic synthetic damage over real crops from ONE field photo; field validation pending

colourShift.test: frozen 130 positive scenes (9 held-out crops) + 40 procedural negatives

white_style.note: desaturated 22% + value x1.35 (white/cream look; ds .22 dv 1.35)

colourShift.scope: colour-shift stress test on the FROZEN synthetic benchmark (crops from ONE field photo); shifts are programmatic HSV re-colourings, NOT photographs of other varieties; the single training variety means out-of-family colours are expected to fail - these are the honest measured numbers
